content.title: What's open on Easter Monday 2026? Status of banks, schools, post offices, and more
content.text: Easter Monday in the United States falls on Monday, April 6, 2026. Unlike some other countries, this day is not a federal holiday in the U.S., which affects what stays open or closed.To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoBecause it has no federal status, most government services and businesses operate as they would on a normal Monday. This includes banks, mail services, and local offices.Banks and financial institutions generally remain open for regular business hours on Easter Monday. Customers can visit branches for routine transactions such as deposits, withdrawals, and account services.4 steps to know who can receive Social Security survivor benefitsThe U.S. Postal Service also typically carries out mail delivery and post office operations on this day, as there is no federal holiday designation that would halt normal postal activities.Government offices, schools, and other servicesMost state and local government offices, including Departments of Motor Vehicles (DMVs) and administrative agencies, remain open on Easter Monday. These offices usually follow their standard Monday schedules.Public school calendars vary by district. Some schools might be closed due to spring break or local scheduling around the Easter weekend, while others stay open if their academic calendars do not include an extended break. Checking with your specific school or district is the best way to confirm.Libraries, municipal facilities, and other community services often follow their usual Monday hours unless local authorities choose to close for unrelated reasons.Retail, transit, and local plansRetail stores and restaurants usually set their own hours for Easter Monday. Many major retailers operate on a normal schedule, though some may adjust opening times based on demand following the holiday weekend. It is wise to check with individual stores before visiting.Public transportation systems typically run regular weekday routes on Easter Monday, but service frequency may still be influenced by local schedules or weekend adjustments earlier in the Easter period.While Easter Monday is not a public holiday at the federal level, the day still carries cultural and community traditions in many areas. Events like the annual White House Easter Egg Roll highlight how some places observe the spirit of the season even though regular services continue.In summary, unless specifically noted by your local government or business, banks, post offices, schools, and most government services are open on Easter Monday 2026, operating under their normal schedules.
